source_policy: Direct publicly available primary source text, company publications and government source summaries cross-checked against frozen issuer group register; some entries have source text only from prior archived review or an issuer report mirror, explicitly marked in source_review_depth. Individual source file archive bytes and review signoff not newly completed.
cutoff_policy: The review executed 2026-10-31 screens stage/status against frozen as-of 2026-10-29; a 2026-10-30 Northern Minerals corporate document is explicitly identified as post-cutoff supplemental only, not eligible as-of evidence. Undated updated web pages must be independently dated before formal snapshot release.
method: One-to-one left join from existing project_entity_register.csv using existing canonical_name and stable review group entity_id; manual cross-check of each group with source URL/text; six mutually exclusive analytical screening classes; preserve original official disposition and recorded stage; no automatic SQL or approved CSV update.
